causes.T: Type sized by convention, not for reading
causes.S: Width taken from the container; space treated as filler
causes.I: Ink and boxes that draw nothing
causes.L: What matters is hidden, volatile or scrolled inside the page
causes.N: Navigation that does not mirror the tree
causes.W: Words written for the writer, not the reader
causes.M: The page speaks for its maker, not its reader
causes.P: The model is checked, not the paint
causes.X: A decision already made is replaced by a default

groups.title: Perception: the eye groups by space, size and contrast before it reads
Meaning: a form and a place each mean one thing
Presence: what matters is on the page, for every input
Voice: the words serve the reader
